findings.label: Server-only ID-number rejection shows the wrong sentence
findings.detail: serverError() chooses COPY.errors.idNumber only when the ASCII-only client looksLikeAadhaar also matches. If the server rejects a non-ASCII digit run in name/district/mandal/note, the UI shows that field's generic message (e.g. 'Keep the note to 500 characters.'). Fix: map any server invalid on those fields whose client checks pass to COPY.errors.idNumber.

findings.label: Unchecked CONSENT_TEXT constant
findings.detail: CONSENT_TEXT is defined but unused, and nothing asserts sha256(CONSENT_TEXT) == CONSENT_TEXT_SHA256. It matches today (checked by hand), but it can drift silently. Fix: add a one-line pytest or remove the constant.
